understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through each level and activate every goal cell by entering it while the carried piece simultaneously matched the goal's required shape, color, and rotation. Completing all goals advances through the levels, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before restoring stamina to its maximum. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A matching goal must be stepped on to complete it; modifier tiles can change the piece and must be used as part of a planned route. In this episode, moving into walls wasted turns and stamina, eventually costing a life, and stepping on a rotation modifier changed the piece from 0° to 270°, preventing the goal from matching until another rotation modifier was reached.
